# v10 Kaggle cells

Run existing-table completion tasks first. N01-N04 contain exactly four new CNN experiments, one backbone per logical block. Every runnable script uses a hard 600-minute planning cap and no kill timer.

## C03_bam - Flowers102 / ResNet-18 / 10ep

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
SESSION_START_EPOCH="$(date +%s)"
TASK_ID="C03_bam"
REPO_URL="${DT1D_CNN_REPO_URL:-https://github.com/tydeptrai21042004/whc-dt1d.git}"; REPO_COMMIT="${DT1D_CNN_COMMIT:-}"
WORKDIR=/kaggle/working; REPO_DIR="$WORKDIR/whc-dt1d-$TASK_ID"; DATA_ROOT="$WORKDIR/data_$TASK_ID"; PROGRESS_ROOT="$WORKDIR/progress_$TASK_ID"; RESULT_ZIP="$WORKDIR/${TASK_ID}_results.zip"; SAFE_MINUTES=600  # hard planning cap: never allow the task planner beyond 10h from session start
export TASK_ID REPO_DIR DATA_ROOT PROGRESS_ROOT RESULT_ZIP SAFE_MINUTES
pack_results() { [[ -d "$PROGRESS_ROOT" ]] || return 0; python - <<'PYZIP'
import os,zipfile
from pathlib import Path
r=Path(os.environ['PROGRESS_ROOT']); d=Path(os.environ['RESULT_ZIP']); d.unlink(missing_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(d,'w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,compresslevel=6) as z:
    for p in r.rglob('*'):
        if p.is_file() and p.suffix.lower() not in {'.pth','.pt','.ckpt'}: z.write(p,p.relative_to(r.parent))
print('RESULT_ZIP=',d)
PYZIP
ls -lh "$RESULT_ZIP" || true; }
trap 'rc=$?; trap - EXIT; pack_results || true; exit $rc' EXIT
rm -rf "$REPO_DIR"; for n in 1 2 3; do git clone --depth 1 "$REPO_URL" "$REPO_DIR" && break || sleep $((n*5)); done; [[ -d "$REPO_DIR/.git" ]] || exit 2
cd "$REPO_DIR"; if [[ -n "$REPO_COMMIT" ]]; then git fetch --depth 1 origin "$REPO_COMMIT"; git checkout --detach "$REPO_COMMIT"; fi; echo SOURCE_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
python -m pip install -q --upgrade-strategy only-if-needed -r requirements-kaggle.txt
python - <<'PYTOOLS'
import base64
from pathlib import Path
Path('/kaggle/working/cnn_safe_task.py').write_bytes(base64.b64decode('')); Path('/kaggle/working/dense_safe_task.py').write_bytes(base64.b64decode('')); Path('/kaggle/working/apply_unified_configs.py').write_bytes(base64.b64decode('')); Path('/kaggle/working/apply_source_fixes.py').write_bytes(base64.b64decode(''))
PYTOOLS
rm -rf "$PROGRESS_ROOT"; python - <<'PYRESTORE'
import os,shutil,zipfile
from pathlib import Path
sid=os.environ['TASK_ID']; out=Path(os.environ['PROGRESS_ROOT']); inp=Path('/kaggle/input'); zs=list(inp.rglob(f'{sid}_results.zip')) if inp.exists() else []
if zs:
 z=max(zs,key=lambda p:p.stat().st_mtime); tmp=Path('/kaggle/working')/f'_restore_{sid}'; shutil.rmtree(tmp,ignore_errors=True); tmp.mkdir(); zipfile.ZipFile(z).extractall(tmp); found=list(tmp.rglob(f'progress_{sid}'))
 if len(found)==1: shutil.move(str(found[0]),str(out)); print('RESTORED',z)
 shutil.rmtree(tmp,ignore_errors=True)
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
PYRESTORE
mkdir -p "$DATA_ROOT" "$PROGRESS_ROOT"; python - <<'PYGPU'
import torch
assert torch.cuda.is_available(),'Enable Kaggle GPU accelerator.'
print('GPU count=',torch.cuda.device_count()); [print(i,torch.cuda.get_device_name(i)) for i in range(torch.cuda.device_count())]
PYGPU
CONFIG_PATH="$REPO_DIR/configs/experiments/table_05.yaml"
python /kaggle/working/apply_unified_configs.py --family cnn "$CONFIG_PATH"
python /kaggle/working/cnn_safe_task.py --repo-root "$REPO_DIR" --config "$CONFIG_PATH" --method "bam" --data-path "$DATA_ROOT" --progress-root "$PROGRESS_ROOT" --safe-minutes "$SAFE_MINUTES" --session-start-epoch "$SESSION_START_EPOCH" --safety-factor 1.60 --reserve-minutes 45 --max-gpus 2
pack_results; trap - EXIT
echo "Inspect $PROGRESS_ROOT/TASK_STATUS.json. If incomplete, upload ${TASK_ID}_results.zip to a fresh session and rerun this exact script."
```
